mainTopic: Whether a טומטום needs a פסוק to exclude it, or is already excluded because it is only a ספק
overview: On the previous amud, the גמרא held that a טומטום is really just a ספק: it is either male or female, and we don't know which. If so, no פסוק should be needed to exclude it. Only an אנדרוגינוס might be a separate kind of being that needs a פסוק. Here the גמרא brings one source after another (about ערכין, שלמים, עולה, bird offerings, and רבי אלעזר's list of animals that cannot become holy) that uses a פסוק or a rule to exclude a טומטום. Each time it answers 'סמי מיכן טומטום': erase the word טומטום from the text. When a version of רבי אלעזר's list counts exactly five, the גמרא swaps טומטום for a יתום (an animal born after its mother died) to keep the count. Finally the גמרא asks whether תנאים already disagreed about this. It brings a ברייתא where removing טומטום would make רבי שמעון בן יהודה say the same thing as the חכמים. This suggests the two views differ precisely about a טומטום, and the discussion continues on the next amud.

steps.title: A ברייתא uses 'הזכר' to exclude a טומטום
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא challenges its view that a טומטום is just a ספק. It cites a ברייתא that uses the word 'הזכר' to exclude both a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.simpleTranslation: Why, then, does a ברייתא teach: 'The male', and not a טומטום or an אנדרוגינוס?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא attacks what it just said. If a טומטום is only a doubt, why does a ברייתא bother using a פסוק to exclude it?
steps.deeperAnalysis: Something that is only a ספק is excluded without any פסוק, because we need a definite male. So when a ברייתא uses a פסוק to exclude a טומטום, it implies that a טומטום is a separate category. That contradicts the גמרא's position.

keyTerms.meaning: Why, then? (an opening for a challenge)
It was taught in a ברייתא
A person or animal whose genitals are covered, so its gender is unknown
A person or animal with both male and female organs
'The male', a word in the פסוק (here, ערכין)

steps.confusionAlert: Don't mix up the two terms. A טומטום is probably one gender that we can't see, so it is a doubt. An אנדרוגינוס has both sets of organs, so it may be a separate kind of being. The whole סוגיא depends on this difference.

phrases.english: Why, then, is it taught:
phrases.notes: The word 'אלמה' signals a challenge against the position just stated.

phrases.english: 'The male' — but not a tumtum or a hermaphrodite!
phrases.notes: From Leviticus 27:3, the section about ערכין (vowed valuations).

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the view, stated on the previous amud, that a טומטום is only a ספק.
steps.kashyaTarget: The claim that a טומטום needs no פסוק because it is only a ספק
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: A ברייתא uses a פסוק to exclude a טומטום. That only makes sense if a טומטום is not automatically excluded.

steps.title: Erase טומטום from the ברייתא
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers that the word טומטום should be removed from the ברייתא. The ברייתא was only talking about an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers by correcting the text of the ברייתא. It says the word טומטום does not belong there.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Once the word טומטום is erased, the ברייתא only uses the פסוק to exclude an אנדרוגינוס. An אנדרוגינוס can be seen as a separate kind of being, so a פסוק for it makes sense. The גמרא's view that a טומטום is just a ספק stays in place.

keyTerms.meaning: Remove! Erase! (an instruction to correct the text)
From here
A doubt; a case whose status is unknown
A separate kind of being (said about an אנדרוגינוס)

steps.whyThisMatters: This answer becomes a fixed formula. The גמרא uses the exact same words for every challenge here.

phrases.english: Omit tumtum from here.
phrases.notes: A textual correction. The ברייתא is read as speaking only about an אנדרוגינוס.

steps.terutzResolutionType: Textual emendation (correcting the wording of the ברייתא)
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The ברייתא as written uses a פסוק to exclude a טומטום.
steps.terutzMaskana: The word טומטום is removed. The ברייתא only excludes an אנדרוגינוס.

steps.title: The rest of the ברייתא pairs 'זכר' with 'נקבה' to exclude a טומטום
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא continues the same ברייתא. It rules out the idea that these people get a woman's ערך, using 'הזכר' together with 'אם נקבה', and again names a טומטום.
steps.simpleTranslation: Come and hear: I might think they don't get a man's ערך but do get a woman's ערך. So the פסוק says 'the male... if a female', and not a טומטום or an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a second challenge from the continuation of that ברייתא. Here a טומטום is excluded from the woman's ערך too, and this is again learned from פסוקים.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This section is longer and builds a full דרשה from two פסוקים. That makes it harder to say the word טומטום was just a mistake. The challenge is still the same: why would a mere ספק need a פסוק?

keyTerms.meaning: Come and hear (introduces a source used as a proof or challenge)
One might have thought (introduces a wrong first assumption)
The fixed amount someone pledges when vowing a person's 'value' to the מקדש
Therefore the פסוק says
Female

phrases.english: Come and hear:
One might think he would not have the valuation of a man,
but he would have the valuation of a woman?
The verse states: 'The male... if a female',
phrases.notes: Leviticus 27:3–4. Only a definite male or a definite female has an ערך.

phrases.english: but not a tumtum or a hermaphrodite!

steps.triggerLanguage: תָּא שְׁמַע: יָכוֹל לֹא יְהֵא בְּעֵרֶךְ אִישׁ

steps.kashyaTarget: The view that a טומטום is only a ספק
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: A careful דרשה from two פסוקים excludes a טומטום. That suggests a טומטום needs a פסוק.

steps.title: Again, erase טומטום
steps.stepSummary: The same answer: remove the word טומטום from this part of the ברייתא.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא gives the same textual correction again.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Without the word טומטום, this דרשה only teaches that an אנדרוגינוס gets neither a man's nor a woman's ערך. The view that a טומטום is a ספק is protected again.

keyTerms.meaning: The laws of vowed valuations of people

phrases.english: Omit tumtum from here.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 3 with the same formula used in step 2.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The ברייתא excludes a טומטום from a woman's ערך by using a פסוק.
steps.terutzMaskana: Only an אנדרוגינוס is excluded by the פסוק.

steps.title: For שלמים, 'אם זכר אם נקבה' means a definite male or female
steps.stepSummary: A new ברייתא about קרבן שלמים reads 'אם זכר אם נקבה' as a definite male or a definite female. It excludes a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.simpleTranslation: Come and hear: 'Whether male or female' means a definite male or a definite female, and not a טומטום or an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a third challenge, this time from the laws of קרבנות. Again a פסוק is used to exclude a טומטום.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This ברייתא says outright that the פסוק requires a 'definite' gender. Someone might argue that this simply restates the idea that a ספק is excluded. Even so, it still lists טומטום as something the פסוק comes to exclude.

keyTerms.meaning: A definite male
A definite female
A peace offering, which may be male or female (Leviticus 3:1)

phrases.english: Come and hear:
'Whether male or female' —
a definite male, a definite female,
but not a tumtum or a hermaphrodite.

steps.triggerLanguage: תָּא שְׁמַע: אִם זָכָר אִם נְקֵבָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: A third challenge, from a new area of law (קרבנות).
steps.kashyaTarget: The view that a טומטום is only a ספק
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Another ברייתא excludes a טומטום from a פסוק.

steps.title: Again, erase טומטום
steps.stepSummary: Same answer: remove the word טומטום from the שלמים ברייתא.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the third challenge with the same correction.
steps.deeperAnalysis: With the word erased, the פסוק is only needed to exclude an אנדרוגינוס. A טומטום is excluded anyway, simply because it is a doubt.

keyTerms.meaning: An offering brought in the מקדש

phrases.english: Omit tumtum from here.

steps.terutzHavaAmina: The שלמים ברייתא excludes a טומטום by using a פסוק.
steps.terutzMaskana: Only an אנדרוגינוס is excluded by the פסוק.

steps.title: For עולה, an extra 'זכר' excludes a טומטום
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא about קרבן עולה uses the first 'זכר' to exclude a female. It uses the second, extra 'זכר' to exclude a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.simpleTranslation: Come and hear: 'The male' excludes a female. When the פסוק later says 'male' again, it wasn't needed. So why does it say it? To exclude a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a fourth and strongest challenge. Here a whole extra word in the תורה is used up just to exclude a טומטום.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The first 'זכר' already excludes a female. The repeated 'זכר' (Leviticus 1:10) is extra, and the ברייתא uses it to exclude a טומטום. If a טומטום were automatically excluded as a ספק, the extra word would seem to have no purpose for it.

keyTerms.meaning: A burnt offering, which must be male
Below, meaning later in the פסוקים
The פסוק did not need to say it (an extra word)
To exclude

phrases.english: Come and hear:
'The male' — but not a female.
phrases.notes: Leviticus 1:3, a burnt offering from cattle.

phrases.english: When it says 'male' below,
phrases.notes: Leviticus 1:10, a burnt offering from sheep.

phrases.english: which the verse did not need to state;

To exclude a tumtum and a hermaphrodite.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: A fourth challenge, which relies on an extra word in the פסוק.
steps.kashyaTarget: The view that a טומטום is only a ספק
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: An extra word is used up to exclude a טומטום. That would be pointless if a טומטום were excluded automatically.

steps.title: Again, erase טומטום
steps.stepSummary: Same answer: remove the word טומטום. The extra 'זכר' only excludes an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the fourth challenge with the same correction. More challenges of this kind follow in the next steps.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Even the extra word is explained without a טומטום: it is needed only for an אנדרוגינוס, which is a separate kind of being. So far, all four challenges are answered the same way, and the view that a טומטום is just a ספק holds up.

keyTerms.meaning: Extra, unneeded (said of a word in a פסוק used for a דרשה)
A law learned from the wording of a פסוק

steps.whatToRemember: So far, every ברייתא that uses a פסוק to exclude a טומטום gets the same answer, 'סמי מיכן טומטום': erase the word. The גמרא holds firm that a טומטום is just a ספק and needs no פסוק. Only an אנדרוגינוס, which may be a separate kind of being, needs a פסוק to exclude it. More challenges of the same kind follow.

phrases.english: Omit tumtum from here.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 7 with the same formula as steps 2, 4, and 6.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: An extra 'זכר' is used up to exclude a טומטום.
steps.terutzMaskana: The extra 'זכר' excludes only an אנדרוגינוס. A טומטום is excluded because it is a ספק.

steps.title: A bird ברייתא lists a טומטום as unfit, even though birds have no male or female requirement
steps.stepSummary: The תנא קמא lists a טומטום bird among birds unfit for the altar. Their מליקה does not make them pure, so they cause impurity in the throat. רבי אליעזר disagrees, because birds have no 'male and female' requirement. This is hard for the view that a טומטום is just a hidden male or female.
steps.simpleTranslation: Come and hear: a bird that was worshipped, one set aside for idol worship, one given as payment to a prostitute, one given as the price of a dog, and a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס all make clothing impure when eaten, at the throat. רבי אליעזר says: a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס do not make clothing impure at the throat. רבי אליעזר used to say: wherever the תורה says 'male and female,' you exclude a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס from them. But for a bird, since the תורה does not say 'male and female' about it, you do not exclude a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings another ברייתא to attack its position. In this ברייתא, the first opinion treats a טומטום bird as unfit for the altar.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A kosher bird that died without proper slaughter (נבלת עוף טהור) makes a person and his clothing impure when he swallows it. A kosher מליקה on a valid bird offering prevents this impurity, but a מליקה on an unfit bird does not. The bird offering has no gender requirement, so if a טומטום is really a male or a female, it should be valid. Why, then, does the תנא קמא call it unfit?

keyTerms.meaning: Come and hear. This introduces a source brought as a proof or a challenge.
The throat. A dead kosher bird causes impurity only when it is swallowed.
Killing a bird offering by pinching its neck with a fingernail.
Payment given to a prostitute. It is forbidden for the altar.
The price of a dog. Something traded for a dog is forbidden for the altar.
An animal that was worshipped as an idol, and one set aside for idol worship.

steps.confusionAlert: The challenge comes from the תנא קמא, the first opinion, who lists טומטום as unfit. It does not come from רבי אליעזר. רבי אליעזר actually agrees that a טומטום bird is fine.

phrases.english: Come and hear:
A bird that was worshipped, and one set aside for idol worship,
and one given as a prostitute's payment, and one given as the price of a dog,
and a tumtum and a hermaphrodite,
all of them make clothing impure when they are in the throat.
phrases.notes: Because these birds are unfit, their pinching does not count as a valid offering, so they stay impure like a dead bird.

phrases.english: Rabbi Eliezer says:
a tumtum and a hermaphrodite do not make impure
clothing when they are in the throat,
phrases.notes: In his view they are valid bird offerings, so the pinching works.

phrases.english: for Rabbi Eliezer used to say:
Wherever the Torah says 'male' and 'female,'
you exclude a tumtum and a hermaphrodite from among them.

phrases.aramaic: וְעוֹף, הוֹאִיל וְלֹא נֶאֱמַר בּוֹ ״זָכָר וּנְקֵבָה״,
phrases.english: But a bird, since 'male' and 'female' is not said about it,

phrases.aramaic: אֵין אַתָּה מוֹצִיא טוּמְטוּם וְאַנְדְּרוֹגִינוֹס מִבֵּינֵיהֶם!
phrases.english: you do not exclude a tumtum and a hermaphrodite from among them!
phrases.notes: The challenge is implied: so why does the first opinion disqualify a טומטום bird?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Another challenge in the same series. This time it comes from bird offerings instead of animal offerings.
steps.kashyaTarget: The view that a טומטום is really a male or a female whose gender is hidden.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Bird offerings have no gender requirement. A hidden male or female bird should therefore be valid. Yet the תנא קמא disqualifies a טומטום, which suggests he treats it as a separate category that is excluded on its own.

steps.title: Remove the word טומטום from the bird ברייתא
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא gives the same fix it used before: the word טומטום should be taken out of this ברייתא.
steps.simpleTranslation: Remove the word טומטום from here.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the challenge by saying the word טומטום does not belong in the תנא קמא's list.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Once the word טומטום is removed, the תנא קמא disqualifies only the אנדרוגינוס bird. That fits the view that a טומטום is just an unknown male or female. This is the fifth time the גמרא uses this same textual fix (after steps 2, 4, 6, and 8).

keyTerms.meaning: Remove from here. The גמרא says a word should be taken out of the text of a ברייתא.
A creature whose sex organs are covered, so we cannot tell if it is male or female.
A creature that has both male and female sex organs.

steps.whatToRemember: In every one of these ברייתות, the גמרא keeps the אנדרוגינוס as excluded but removes the טומטום. The גמרא holds that a טומטום is really male or female and just hidden. An אנדרוגינוס may be a different kind of creature altogether.

phrases.english: Remove 'tumtum' from here.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge of step 9 using the same method as steps 2, 4, 6, and 8.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Textual emendation: a word is removed from the ברייתא.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The ברייתא seemed to treat a טומטום as its own excluded category, even where gender does not matter.
steps.terutzMaskana: The word טומטום is not part of the correct text. Only the אנדרוגינוס is disqualified.

steps.title: רבי אלעזר lists a טומטום among animals that cannot become holy at all
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא brings רבי אלעזר's teaching. A טריפה, כלאים, an animal born by caesarean, a טומטום, and an אנדרוגינוס cannot become holy, and they cannot make a substitute animal holy. This sets up a new challenge.
steps.simpleTranslation: Come and hear: רבי אלעזר says: a טריפה, a כלאים animal, an animal born by caesarean section, a טומטום, and an אנדרוגינוס do not become holy, and they do not make other animals holy.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is setting up a new challenge by quoting רבי אלעזר. He places a טומטום among animals that cannot become holy at all.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Some offerings, like a שלמים, can be male or female. So if a טומטום is just a hidden male or female, it should be able to become holy at least for that kind of offering. רבי אלעזר says it cannot become holy at all, which seems to treat it as a separate excluded category. 'Do not make holy' means they cannot create a תמורה: if someone tries to swap another animal for one of them, the swap does not make the other animal holy.

keyTerms.meaning: An animal with a fatal defect that will cause it to die.
An animal born from two different species mixed together.
An animal born by caesarean section, through the side of the mother.
They do not become holy, and they do not make a substitute animal (תְּמוּרָה) holy.

steps.confusionAlert: Do not confuse רבי אלעזר here with רבי אליעזר in the previous ברייתא. They are two different תנאים.

phrases.english: Come and hear: Rabbi Elazar says:
An animal with a fatal defect, a mixed-breed animal, and one born by caesarean section,
a tumtum and a hermaphrodite —
do not become holy and do not make another animal holy.
phrases.notes: This refers to תמורה, the attempt to swap another animal into holiness in its place.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: After answering the bird ברייתא, the גמרא brings a new source to challenge the same view.
steps.kashyaTarget: The view that a טומטום is really a male or a female whose gender is hidden.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: A hidden male or female could at least become holy as a שלמים, which allows both genders. Saying a טומטום cannot become holy at all suggests it is treated as a separate creature. Step 12 completes the challenge, and step 13 answers it.

steps.title: שמואל explains: these animals have no part in substitution
steps.stepSummary: שמואל explains רבי אלעזר's teaching. These animals cannot become holy through תמורה, and they cannot make another animal holy as their substitute. Since a טומטום is on the list, this is hard for the view that a טומטום is just a hidden male or female.
steps.simpleTranslation: And שמואל said: they do not become holy through substitution, and they do not make another animal holy as their substitute!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא finishes the challenge it started in Step 11. It uses שמואל's explanation of what 'not holy and not making holy' means.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If a טומטום were really a male or a female, it should be able to take part in תמורה like any normal animal. Yet the list says it cannot. This suggests a טומטום is its own separate kind of creature.

keyTerms.meaning: Substitution: trying to swap a regular animal for a holy one, which makes both holy
They do not become holy
They make another animal holy

phrases.english: And Shmuel said:
they do not become holy through substitution,
phrases.notes: If someone tries to swap one of these for a holy animal, it does not become holy.

phrases.english: and they do not make another animal holy as a substitute!
phrases.notes: If one of these was born holy, swapping a regular animal for it does nothing.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes the challenge introduced in Step 11
steps.kashyaTarget: The view that a טומטום is just a hidden male or female
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: A real male or female can take part in תמורה. Putting טומטום on the list implies it is a separate creature.

steps.title: Same fix: remove טומטום from the list
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers as before: take טומטום out of this teaching.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the challenge with the same fix it has used several times: the word טומטום does not belong in this teaching.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Once טומטום is removed, the list only names animals that really cannot be used. The view that a טומטום is a doubtful male or female stays safe.

keyTerms.meaning: Remove from here (cross out a word in the text)

phrases.english: Remove tumtum from here.

steps.terutzHavaAmina: The list includes טומטום, so it seems to be a separate creature
steps.terutzMaskana: טומטום is not really part of this teaching

steps.title: A version that counts five animals
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא brings a version of רבי אלעזר's teaching that gives a number: 'five' animals. טומטום is one of the five.
steps.simpleTranslation: Come and hear: רבי אלעזר says, five animals do not become holy and do not make holy. They are: a טריפה, כלאים, an animal born by caesarean, a טומטום, and an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a version of the same teaching that adds the number 'five.' It is setting up a problem for the 'remove טומטום' fix.
steps.deeperAnalysis: When a teaching gives an exact count, you cannot simply cross out an item without breaking the number. So this version seems to lock טומטום into the list.

keyTerms.meaning: Come and hear (introduces a source used as proof or challenge)
Five
An animal born by caesarean section

phrases.english: Come and hear:
Rabbi Elazar says:
five do not become holy and do not make holy,
and these are they: the tereifa, and the mixed breed,
and the caesarean-born, and the tumtum, and the androginos.

steps.triggerLanguage: תָּא שְׁמַע: רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר אוֹמֵר: חֲמִשָּׁה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Brings a new version of the source that threatens the fix in Step 13
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The teaching gives an exact count of five, and טומטום is one of them.

steps.title: Removing טומטום would leave only four
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא rules out the usual fix ahead of time. If you remove טומטום, only four are left, but the teaching says five.
steps.simpleTranslation: And if you say, here too remove טומטום, then there are only four!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא blocks the answer it gave in Step 13 before anyone can use it here.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The number 'five' shows that טומטום was meant to be on the list. Crossing it out would leave the count wrong.

keyTerms.meaning: And if you would say (brings up a possible answer, usually to reject it)
Then there are only four

phrases.english: And if you would say, here too
remove tumtum from here —
then they are only four!

steps.triggerLanguage: וְכִי תֵּימָא הָכָא נָמֵי סְמִי מִיכָּן טוּמְטוּם
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Sharpens Step 14 by ruling out the earlier fix
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: The 'remove טומטום' fix, as applied to this version
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: It breaks the stated count of five

steps.title: Swap טומטום for a יתום (orphan animal)
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers: take out טומטום and put in a יתום, an animal born after its mother died. That keeps the count at five.
steps.simpleTranslation: Take out טומטום and bring in יתום.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא fixes the count problem by replacing טומטום with another unfit animal, the יתום.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A יתום is also unfit as a קרבן, so it fits the list well. Now the list still has five items, and טומטום is no longer one of them.

keyTerms.meaning: Take out
Bring in, insert
An 'orphan' animal, born after its mother died

steps.confusionAlert: Here יתום does not mean a human orphan. It means an animal born after its mother died.

phrases.english: Take out tumtum, and bring in orphan.

steps.terutzHavaAmina: The count of five locks טומטום into the list
steps.terutzMaskana: The fifth item is really יתום, not טומטום
steps.whatToRemember: Each ברייתא that treated טומטום as a separate creature has been fixed by removing it. In the counted version, יתום takes its place.

steps.title: Is this a dispute between תנאים?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא suggests that whether a טומטום is a doubt or a separate creature is a dispute between תנאים. It brings a ברייתא about an אנדרוגינוס בכור with three views.
steps.simpleTranslation: Shall we say this is a dispute between תנאים? רבי אילעאי says in the name of רבי ישמעאל: an אנדרוגינוס is a בכור, and its blemish comes with it. The חכמים say: holiness does not take hold of it. רבי שמעון בן יהודה says in the name of רבי שמעון: the verse says 'the male,' and wherever 'male' is said, it comes only to exclude a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא stops fixing texts and asks a new question. Maybe תנאים themselves disagreed about what a טומטום is. It brings a ברייתא to check.
steps.deeperAnalysis: There are three views here. רבי ישמעאל holds that an אנדרוגינוס is a בכור whose odd body counts as a blemish. The חכמים hold it is not holy at all. רבי שמעון says the word 'זכר' leaves out both a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס, which sounds like treating a טומטום as a separate creature.

keyTerms.meaning: Shall we say this is a dispute between תנאים?
Firstborn male animal, which is holy from birth
Its blemish is with it (born already blemished)
Holiness does not take hold of it

phrases.english: Shall we say it is a dispute of Tannaim?

phrases.aramaic: רַבִּי אִילְעַאי אוֹמֵר מִשּׁוּם רַבִּי יִשְׁמָעֵאל:
phrases.english: Rabbi Ilai says in the name of Rabbi Yishmael:
an androginos is a firstborn, and its blemish is with it,
phrases.notes: It is holy as a בכור, but being an אנדרוגינוס counts as a blemish.

phrases.aramaic: וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים: אֵין קְדוּשָּׁה חָלָה עָלָיו.
phrases.english: and the Sages say: holiness does not take hold of it.

phrases.aramaic: רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר מִשּׁוּם רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן:
phrases.english: Rabbi Shimon ben Yehuda says in the name of Rabbi Shimon:
behold it says 'the male',
and every place that 'male' is said
it is only to exclude a tumtum and an androginos.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves from fixing single texts to asking whether the question of טומטום is a dispute between תנאים
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Do תנאים disagree about whether a טומטום is a doubt or a separate creature?

steps.title: Removing טומטום would make רבי שמעון say the same as the חכמים
steps.stepSummary: If we removed טומטום from רבי שמעון בן יהודה's words, he would be saying exactly what the חכמים said. That cannot be right.
steps.simpleTranslation: And if you say, remove טומטום from here, then רבי שמעון בן יהודה is the same as the רבנן!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא shows that the usual 'remove טומטום' fix does not work in this ברייתא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Without טומטום, רבי שמעון would only be leaving out an אנדרוגינוס, which is just what the חכמים already said. A ברייתא would not list a separate opinion that adds nothing.

keyTerms.meaning: That is the same as the רבנן

phrases.english: And if you would say: remove tumtum from here,

phrases.aramaic: רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן יְהוּדָה הַיְינוּ רַבָּנַן!
phrases.english: Rabbi Shimon ben Yehuda is the same as the Rabbis!

steps.triggerLanguage: וְכִי תֵּימָא: סְמִי מִיכָּן טוּמְטוּם, רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן יְהוּדָה הַיְינוּ רַבָּנַן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Blocks the textual fix for the ברייתא in Step 17
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Removing טומטום from רבי שמעון בן יהודה's words
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: It would leave his view the same as the חכמים, so it would be a pointless extra opinion

steps.title: The real difference between them is the טומטום
steps.stepSummary: So the disagreement must be about a טומטום. The חכמים (the first תנא) only said an אנדרוגינוס is not holy. They hold a טומטום is a doubt, so it is holy out of doubt. רבי שמעון then comes to add something (the text continues on the next amud).
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, is it not that טומטום is the difference between them? The first תנא holds that 'holiness does not take hold of it' refers to the אנדרוגינוס, but a טומטום is a doubt and is holy because of the doubt. And רבי שמעון comes…
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא proposes what the two views really disagree about: the status of a טומטום. The sentence about רבי שמעון's view continues on the next amud.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The חכמים see a טומטום as a hidden male or female, so it is holy out of doubt. רבי שמעון leaves it out with the word 'זכר,' which treats it as a separate creature. This would show that our question is an old dispute between תנאים.

keyTerms.meaning: Rather, is it not that… (brings a proposed explanation)
There is a difference between them
The first תנא (here, the חכמים)
Holy because of a doubt

steps.confusionAlert: The 'first תנא' here means the חכמים, not רבי ישמעאל. Their words 'holiness does not take hold of it' were only about the אנדרוגינוס.

phrases.english: Rather, is it not that tumtum is the difference between them,
for the first Tanna holds:
'holiness does not take hold of it' refers to the androginos,
but a tumtum is a doubt
and is holy because of the doubt,
and Rabbi Shimon comes
phrases.notes: The sentence continues on the next amud.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Since the textual fix failed in Step 18, the גמרא infers that the dispute is about טומטום
steps.raayaObject: That whether a טומטום is a doubt or a separate creature is a dispute between תנאים
steps.raayaSupportSource: The ברייתא of רבי אילעאי, the חכמים, and רבי שמעון בן יהודה
steps.whyThisMatters: If this holds, the earlier ברייתות did not need to be changed. They could simply follow רבי שמעון's view that a טומטום is a separate creature.
